timeline_convention: Controls are presented at absolute frame zero and sanitized into one coherent accepted Controls value at the next persistent 16-frame quantum. Each lane boundary and local accepted trigger occurs before only that lane's source render for the quantum. All eight voices render in fixed lane order, with their random context restored immediately before and saved immediately after each source call. The final mixer runs after all voices. Outer host blocks only copy persistent carry and never realign scheduler, random, source, mixer, or snapshot state.
